page_topic_one_liner: Web Fetch — URL to LLM-ready Markdown, stripping ads/nav chrome for 60–98% token savings in agent and RAG pipelines
differentiator_vs_generic: This is the 'read' primitive for agents (URL → clean Markdown), NOT web search (find URLs) or bulk scraping (ETL crawl). Hero must show noisy HTML page transforming into clean Markdown with token-savings badge — NOT a search results page or spider crawl map.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): URL-to-Markdown pipeline — left: messy HTML page mockup with ad banners, nav bar, cookie banner overlays (grey noise blocks); center: accent filter/funnel arrow; right: clean Markdown document with heading/list/code structure; token savings badge '60–98%' on arrow
Secondary: URL prefix bar motif — blurred 'r.jina.ai/' prepended to generic URL (no Jina logo)
Tertiary: agent pipeline strip — Search → Fetch → Read → Answer with Fetch step accent-highlighted
anti_patterns: Search engine results page as hero (page is fetch not search)
Bulk crawl sitemap spider web (page is single-URL read)
Headless browser interaction UI (page is read-only fetch)
